The result precisely locates the first finite-space size where even their combined data fails to determine weak homotopy, with an S^2 versus contractible contrast; it distinguishes joint from individual graph-recovery power and supplies an exact, exhaustive and mathematically motivated threshold rather than an unmotivated small-case table.
